field-text.$description: The other half of the coarse-pointer contract. --target-floor sizes the BOX; this sizes the TYPED TEXT. iOS Safari zooms the whole page when a focused input renders text below 16px and never zooms back out, so the layout an operator was reading shifts the moment they tap a field. Same mechanism as target.*: a 0px floor that the @media (pointer: coarse) block and the [data-input] override raise, consumed as max(--text-sm, --field-text-floor) so it composes over register density and is authoring-overridable for a known desk.
